headline: Live updates: Trump 'surprised' UK freed airbase suspects on bail
summary: The US has rejected an Iranian seven-day roadmap tied to reopening the Strait of Hormuz, according to live coverage. The strait remains a key route for oil shipments.
why: The Strait of Hormuz is a major chokepoint for global crude and liquefied natural gas shipments, so its status directly affects energy markets.
